# DigitalYogi

> DigitalYogi teaches working backend developers: Java, Spring Boot, microservices, system design and AI system design, in short, practical videos and courses. Run by DigitalYogi Lab (OPC) Private Limited, Bengaluru, India.

AI agents: the live course catalog is available over MCP (Streamable HTTP, no auth) at https://learn.digitalyogi.tech/mcp
Tools: list_courses, get_course, get_kb_pro, search_catalog, list_free_resources. Up-to-date catalog in plain text: https://learn.digitalyogi.tech/llms.txt

## Learn (courses)

- [DigitalYogi Learn](https://learn.digitalyogi.tech/): video courses for backend developers. Lesson 1 of every course is a free preview.
- [AI System Design in 60 Minutes](https://learn.digitalyogi.tech/courses/ai-system-design): free course. Eight short lessons on one project: request path, RAG, caching and cost, agents, guardrails, evaluation and monitoring.

## KB Pro (interview practice)

- [KB Pro](https://learn.digitalyogi.tech/kb-pro): practise system design, LLD and DSA by writing your own answer; AI grades it and shows a worked senior-level answer. One-time payment in INR, 7-day full refund.
- [KB free preview](https://kb.digitalyogi.tech/): try KB with Google sign-in.

## On this site

- [Courses](https://digitalyogi.tech/courses/): every DigitalYogi course, free and paid.
- [KB practice](https://digitalyogi.tech/kb/): how KB system design, LLD and DSA practice works.
- [About](https://digitalyogi.tech/about/): what DigitalYogi is and how lessons are built.

## Free resources

- [12 System Design Cheat Sheets](https://learn.digitalyogi.tech/system-design-cheat-sheets): free PDF on caching, databases, Kafka vs RabbitMQ, rate limiting, sharding and more.
- [YouTube @digitalyogi_labs](https://www.youtube.com/@digitalyogi_labs): short videos on Java, Spring Boot, system design and AI.
- Instagram [@digitalyogi_labs](https://www.instagram.com/digitalyogi_labs) · X [@digitalyogilabs](https://x.com/digitalyogilabs)
